notes: Release 0.11 - flash this instead of 0.10. Two package faults are fixed: AutoKit was in the zip but never extracted, so it was silently skipped and the mirroring dongle had no system app; and the keyboard lost a boot race on a freshly flashed unit, coming up registered but not enabled. The keyboard now re-asserts itself after boot and watches the setting, so it no longer matters when the ROM writes. Everything from 0.10 is included: the cockpit rail with HOME, the Control Center on the car own panel with ambient and privacy, and the two layouts separated in code.
